installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Tidy Installation Script
# Server Files Path: /mnt/server
set -eu

PROJECT=tidy

cd /mnt/server

if which tidy >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[✓] Tidy is already pre-installed in the container image!"
else
    # Fallback for standard Yolks images: download static binary
    apk update && apk add --no-cache curl jq git
    GITHUB_REPO="Kenzi-Siaufandi/tidy"

    ARCH="$(uname -m)"
    case "${ARCH}" in
        x86_64|amd64) GOARCH=amd64 ;;
        aarch64|arm64) GOARCH=arm64 ;;
        *) echo "[!] Unsupported architecture: ${ARCH}"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    OS="$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
    case "${OS}" in
        linux) GOOS=linux ;;
        *) echo "[!] Unsupported OS: ${OS} (only linux is supported)"; exit 1 ;;
    esac

    CHECKSUM_URL=""
    if [ "${TIDY_VERSION:-latest}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${TIDY_VERSION:-}" ]; then
        echo "Resolving latest tidy release for ${GOOS}/${GOARCH}..."
        RELEASE_JSON="$(curl -fsSL "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/latest")"
        DOWNLOAD_URL="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r --arg goos "${GOOS}" --arg goarch "${GOARCH}" '.assets[] | select(.name | test("tidy-.*-" + $goos + "-" + $goarch + "$")) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)"
        CHECKSUM_URL="$(printf '%s' "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r --arg goos "${GOOS}" --arg goarch "${GOARCH}" '.assets[] | select(.name | test("tidy-.*-" + $goos + "-" + $goarch + "\\.sha256$")) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)"
    else
        TAG="${TIDY_VERSION}"
        case "${TAG}" in
            v*) ;;
            *) TAG="v${TAG}" ;;
        esac
        DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/download/${TAG}/tidy-${TAG}-${GOOS}-${GOARCH}"
        CHECKSUM_URL="${DOWNLOAD_URL}.sha256"
    fi

    if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ]; then
        echo "[!] No matching tidy binary found for ${GOOS}/${GOARCH} (version: ${TIDY_VERSION:-latest})"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Downloading Tidy from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
    curl -fsSL -o tidy "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

    if [ -n "${CHECKSUM_URL:-}" ] && [ "${CHECKSUM_URL}" != "null" ]; then
        echo "Verifying checksum..."
        if curl -fsSL -o tidy.sha256 "${CHECKSUM_URL}"; then
            EXPECTED="$(cut -d ' ' -f 1 tidy.sha256 | tr -d '\r\n')"
            ACTUAL="$(sha256sum tidy | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
            rm -f tidy.sha256
            if [ "${EXPECTED}" != "${ACTUAL}" ]; then
                echo "[!] Checksum mismatch: expected ${EXPECTED}, got ${ACTUAL}"
                rm -f tidy
                exit 1
            fi
        else
            echo "[!] Warning: checksum file not found at ${CHECKSUM_URL}, skipping verification"
        fi
    fi

    chmod +x tidy
    if ! ./tidy --version; then
        echo "[!] Downloaded tidy binary failed to run"
        rm -f tidy
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "[✓] Tidy downloaded successfully!"
fi
